about.name: Hugo Dorne
about.title: Senior Software Engineer & Scrum Master
about.summary:
Full Stack and AI developments. Main stack: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Spring AI, LangChain.
Project management as a Scrum Master in SAFe environments, team supervision, estimation and pre-sales.

description: Traveler information team: itinerary suggestions, real-time schedules and nearby mobility options, in apps used in over half of the French cities running a multimodal mobility service
Scrum Master of a cross-functional team of six — two backend, iOS, Android, web and QA — coordinating with the other teams under SAFe
Build the backend-for-frontend on Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, exposing itineraries and travel information to the mobile clients
Maintain the real-time stack — WebSocket subscriptions backed by Redis, delivering live updates on the trips each client follows — including a refactor of its Livemap map module
Keep backward compatibility with older mobile app versions while shipping new features
Version upgrades, preventive maintenance and code quality across all of the team's applications
Built AI agents and tools with LangChain4J and Spring AI, exposed over MCP, such as a Gherkin / Cucumber test generator from user stories
Shipped a RAG letting users query Confluence and the company's other sources of truth in natural language through a chatbot
Designed a custom, reusable Confluence vectorization solution, before the Confluence MCPs existed
Took part in the estimation and pre-sales of a €400k application
Contributed to the development, implementation and architecture of MANE's new product lifecycle management (PLM) platform
On TWINS, its vector search for products with similar compositions and flavors: defined the client's problems and needs, the solution, the architecture and the estimate
Owned the development, on a hexagonal architecture with Java 21, Spring Boot 3, pgVector, Nx and Angular 18
Supervised a team of 6 software engineers, part of the team based in India, on a project run entirely in English
Digitized the prison administration's processes through a Spring Boot and Angular web application, for a nationwide rollout across French prisons
Scrum Master within an agile release train, on cross-functional teams of seven
Mentored an intern and an apprentice

experiences.client: Ministries of the Interior and Justice
description: Designed and built an admin dashboard in Java and Angular for a French naturalization management application
Developed, tested and maintained web applications, automated unit and regression tests
